data.fund_name: Bank of India Conservative Hybrid Fund
data.fund_type: An open ended hybrid scheme investing predominantly in debt instruments
data.investment_objective: The Scheme seeks to generate regular income through investments in ﬁxed income securities and also to generate long termcapital appreciation by investing a portion in equity and equity related instruments. However, there can be no assurance that theincome can be generated, regular or otherwise, or the investment objectives of the Scheme will be realized.
